decisions.reason: As a height-adjustable executive desk system with its own page, it fits an established German furniture maker's core offer and looks like a strategic product rather than a short test.
A chair family is a standard range-building product in furniture, and a dedicated webpage suggests the firm intends to support it beyond the launch year.
Floor cushions made from carpets look more like a niche design experiment than a core furniture line, so despite having its own page they are relatively likely to be withdrawn if demand is limited.
The soft upholstered sofa was only mentioned on the website rather than given a full product page, which signals weaker commitment and a higher chance of early discontinuation.
A high standing table is close to workplace and meeting furniture trends, and its own page indicates the firm sees it as a meaningful part of the portfolio.
The rug collection is somewhat peripheral for a furniture manufacturer, but the dedicated presentation suggests enough strategic design value to keep it on the market for now.
